method.baseline: First six 3-sentence contexts with raw response at least 0.50
method.contiguous: Strongest 1 to 3 consecutive eligible sentences in one paragraph, all positive log odds; mean odds plus weakest odds times 0.25 per added sentence
method.decision: At least three held works with a newly half-covered gold span across both generators, at most two additional untouched works, no new conclusion or confidence
method.fit: Second-highest untouched source maximum for each arm, separate from held source IDs; also measure unchanged prior isolated point
method.hit: At least 0.30 nonspace IoU with all authored spans and 0.50 edited-character recall within one highlighted range; additionally measure any half-covered gold span and union character recall
method.isolated: Max independent exact-sentence log odds, sentences with 60 or more nonspace characters
